info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Interface — Security & Access Control
info.description:
Interface security: 802.1X, MAB, MACsec, trust boundaries, access sessions.

**Representative type:** GigabitEthernet (paths work identically for TenGigabitEthernet, HundredGigE, Loopback, Vlan, Tunnel, etc. — just substitute the type name in the URL).

**All 57 interface types:** ATM, ATM-ACR, AppGigabitEthernet, AppNav-Compress, AppNav-UnCompress, Async, BD-VIF, BDI, Bundle, CEM, CEM-ACR, Cellular, Dialer, Embedded-Service-Engine, Ethernet, Ethernet-Internal, FastEthernet, FiftyGigabitEthernet, FiveGigabitEthernet, FortyGigabitEthernet...
